text: I was scared the woman would catch sight of me, for I was full in the moonlight. I tried to move back a bit. The jerk I gave was too much for that rotten old branch. With an almighty crash, down it came, and Julius P. Hersheimmer with it!” “Oh, Julius,” breathed Tuppence, “how exciting! Go on.” “Well, luckily for me, I pitched down into a good soft bed of earth--but it put me out of action for the time, sure enough.
